anomalies.description: A soldier in tactical gear is seen aiming a rifle toward the left side of the street while smoke/dust rises in the background; the posture and sustained aim across multiple frames (f3–f8) indicate active engagement, consistent with firing or imminent firing.

A close-up of a soldier raising and aiming a rifle with visible muzzle device and optics; the weapon is elevated and pointed forward, suggesting active targeting or recent discharge, supported by the focused stance and equipment configuration.

A heavily armed individual in tactical gear points a handgun at a civilian driver inside a taxi, holding the weapon to the driver's head and maintaining the threat for several seconds while military vehicles are visible outside.

A person in military-style attire points a handgun at the head of a seated civilian man inside a vehicle; the gun is pressed against his temple in a threatening manner, with no indication of mutual combat or self-defense.

A person in military-style gear holds a pistol directly against the temple of a seated man wearing a hat inside a vehicle; the man appears restrained and helpless, with no resistance or mutual engagement.
The handgun is fired: visible muzzle flash and recoil are evident in frame f12 (122.0s), and the gun is seen recoiling backward in f13 (122.5s), consistent with discharge.

The armed individual, now outside the vehicle, points the pistol at the seated man's head through the open window, maintaining a threatening posture with the gun aimed at his face/temple; the victim remains passive and vulnerable.

A person in tactical gear draws and aims a semi-automatic pistol at a vehicle occupant; multiple frames show the weapon pointed directly at the target with finger on trigger, consistent with an imminent or ongoing shooting.
Two soldiers in camouflage engage in physical combat with a person inside or emerging from the driver's side of a white-and-red sedan; they pull the individual out while grappling.

A subdued individual lies on the ground while multiple soldiers stand over and physically restrain them, including kneeling on or near their torso and head; the victim appears helpless and non-resisting.

Blurred motion in lower body frames suggests close physical struggle or grappling between individuals; one figure in camouflage appears to be engaging another person on the ground or in close contact.

A soldier in camouflage is seen physically restraining and escorting a civilian man in a light-colored shirt, with the civilian appearing passive and unresisting, consistent with abuse of a helpless individual.

A heavily armed individual in tactical gear points a handgun at a civilian driver inside a taxi, holding the weapon to the driver's head and maintaining the threat for several seconds while military vehicles are visible outside.

A person in military-style attire points a handgun at the head of a seated civilian man inside a vehicle; the gun is pressed against his temple in a threatening manner, with no indication of mutual combat or self-defense.
The handgun is fired: visible muzzle flash and recoil are evident in frame f12 (122.0s), and the gun is seen recoiling backward in f13 (122.5s), consistent with discharge.

A person in military-style gear holds a pistol directly against the temple of a seated man wearing a hat inside a vehicle; the man appears restrained and helpless, with no resistance or mutual engagement.

The armed individual, now outside the vehicle, points the pistol at the seated man's head through the open window, maintaining a threatening posture with the gun aimed at his face/temple; the victim remains passive and vulnerable.

A person in tactical gear draws and aims a semi-automatic pistol at a vehicle occupant; multiple frames show the weapon pointed directly at the target with finger on trigger, consistent with an imminent or ongoing shooting.
Two soldiers in camouflage engage in physical combat with a person inside or emerging from the driver's side of a white-and-red sedan; they pull the individual out while grappling.

A subdued individual lies on the ground while multiple soldiers stand over and physically restrain them, including kneeling on or near their torso and head; the victim appears helpless and non-resisting.

A soldier in camouflage is seen physically restraining and escorting a civilian man in a light-colored shirt, with the civilian appearing passive and unresisting, consistent with abuse of a helpless individual.

Blurred motion in lower body frames suggests close physical struggle or grappling between individuals; one figure in camouflage appears to be engaging another person on the ground or in close contact.
